hook: Engineers pushed a 13.46 meter machine 65 meters beneath the Panama Canal.

sections.voiceover: Engineers pushed a 13.46 meter machine 65 meters beneath the Panama Canal.
sections.visual_cue: Detailed cross-section diagram showing a massive 13.46-meter tunnel boring machine operating deep beneath the seabed of the Panama Canal.
sections.sfx_cue: Low deep mechanical rumble with underwater pressure hum.
b_roll: 3D schematic cutaway of Panama Canal bedrock with tunnel boring machine submerged underneath
sections.transition_out: Fast whip pan downward into the tunnel excavation site

sections.voiceover: In late 2024, Metro de Panamá started tunneling from Farfán. How did crews extract 700,000 cubic meters of rock below the water?
sections.visual_cue: Map animation showing the tunnel path from Farfán across to Albrook station, transitioning to footage of rock excavation.
sections.sfx_cue: Heavy industrial machinery grinding sound transitioning to quiet suspense surge.
b_roll: Map graphic of Panama Metro Line 3 route connecting Farfán to Albrook
Heavy earthmoving equipment hauling excavated tunnel rock
sections.transition_out: Quick dissolve to close-up of Herrenknecht cutterhead

sections.voiceover: However, the Herrenknecht Mixshield machine had to dig 65 meters beneath mean sea level.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up render of the Herrenknecht Mixshield cutterhead rotating slowly under massive hydro-static soil forces.
sections.sfx_cue: Metallic clank followed by pressurized fluid hiss.
b_roll: Technical blueprint diagram of Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM pressure shield assembly
sections.transition_out: Flash cut to tunnel breakthrough point

sections.voiceover: On October 26, 2026, the cutter completed the 4.5 kilometer drive. Metro de Panamá confirmed it reached 65 meters below sea level.
sections.visual_cue: Archival graphics and footage of the tunnel breakthrough at Albrook station, showing the completed 4.5-kilometer concrete lined tunnel.
sections.sfx_cue: Echoing industrial noise fading into low ambient drone.
b_roll: Breakthrough scene of TBM entering Albrook station vault
Interior view of finished reinforced concrete tunnel tube
sections.transition_out: Slow zoom out along the illuminated tunnel interior

sections.voiceover: The 4.5 kilometer tunnel now runs beneath the Pacific entrance.
sections.visual_cue: Wide aerial shot of ships traversing the Pacific entrance of the Panama Canal directly above the subterranean metro link.
sections.sfx_cue: Distant ship horn blending with sub-bass resolve.
b_roll: Aerial view of cargo ships passing over the Pacific entrance of the Panama Canal
